sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nentres, also called Nentres of Garlot, is an Arthurian hero. He ranks among the lesser players of the Arthurian tales. He opposed Arthur at the start of the reign. Later he married Elaine, the half sister of Arthur. Through that union he became an ally of the king.

okr.objective: Nentres of Garlot is a minor Arthurian hero who became an ally.
key_results: He is a minor figure in the stories of King Arthur.
